summary: Verified the creator-spot-free-unlock feature (SQL 022 + fundort.$id.tsx ownSpot bypass). Backend suite (54 tests) and frontend typecheck pass. Fixed a stale existing browser-check fixture that accidentally used the logged-in user's own id as the spot author (which the new fix now correctly treats as an own-spot bypass), then added a dedicated browser check proving own-spot detail pages never render the lock panel even when the backend mock returns locked/priced data.
action_items: No Supabase/Lovable credentials are available in this environment, so the authenticated own-spot flow is verified via source-code review + a mocked-session browser check + the static SQL migration tests, not a real logged-in session against production Supabase. Confirm end-to-end with a real account after manual execution of docs/migrations/022_eigene_fundorte_freigeschaltet.sql in Lovable/Supabase.
Production deployment of this Preview tree (and the SQL migration) is still pending per the briefing; no action needed from testing, flagging for visibility.

checks.criterion: Backend makes creator access free and server-enforced / counter excludes own spots / pending-rejected blocked / idempotency unchanged
checks.name: test_tscheck_sql022_creator_unlock.py
checks.evidence: pytest -q: 54 passed, 1 warning in 5.83s (full suite including test_tscheck_sql022_creator_unlock.py::test_creator_is_free_and_not_recorded_as_unlock, test_free_counter_excludes_creator_owned_spots, test_pending_and_rejected_spots_are_not_unlockable, test_unlock_is_idempotent_and_debits_only_after_insert, test_rpc_is_server_side_and_authenticated_only — all assert against docs/migrations/022_eigene_fundorte_freigeschaltet.sql content).

checks.criterion: Own approved spots are free and have no unlock window
checks.name: own-approved-spot-no-unlock-panel-mocked
checks.evidence: Mocked authenticated session with spot author_id==user.id; backend RPCs mocked to return locked/priced data (my_spot_access=false, preview cost=150) to prove the frontend bypasses them for own spots. Assertions: getByTestId('spot-locked-panel') count 0, getByTestId('spot-unlock-button') count 0, spot title visible. Source confirms: src/routes/fundort.$id.tsx line 26 `ownSpot = !!user && s?.authorId === user.id`; line 28 disables useSpotAccess/useSpotUnlockPreview queries `!!user && !ownSpot`; line 32-33 guard lock/loading panels with `!ownSpot`.

checks.criterion: Existing foreign spot pricing and idempotency stay unchanged
checks.name: locked-spot-shows-server-price-free-and-paid
checks.evidence: Fixed a stale fixture (author_id was accidentally == logged-in user id, making Playwright's first run correctly fail after the fix since it's now an own-spot). Updated author_id to a distinct id (55555555-...). Re-ran: both free-remaining (cost 0, 'Free unlock') and paid (cost 150, 'Unlock for 150 Coins') scenarios render spot-locked-panel + spot-unlock-price + spot-unlock-button correctly for a foreign spot.
